note: Tao surveys three recent results obtained with heavy AI assistance: a human-readable, Lean-formalised proof of finite-time blow-up for the unforced 3D Euler equations (Alpöge, Buckmaster, Coiculescu); a Lean-formalised Navier–Stokes blow-up proof (Alpöge, Buckmaster) that he says still needs a proper, professionally written version; and an enormous Lean-only proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis generated by Alpöge with an internal AI model, whose checking is still under way.
title: Unforced Euler singularity, unforced Navier-Stokes singularity, and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
